write_symbols: cache version and root substitution controls
lease.root_owned_surfaces: Cargo manifests, Cargo.lock, public command catalog, dispatcher, plugin manifests, marketplaces, migration registry, generated authority, claims, release state, and acceptance records are forbidden
lease.external_effects: Only locked and offline Cargo builds/tests in isolated /private/tmp target and scratch roots are authorized

required_behavior: CacheSnapshot retains the canonical plugin_id, version, marketplace identity, and cache_root_id established by read-only reconciliation.
Cache promotion compares plugin_id and version with the bound package source and cache_root_id with the journey home identity before constructing SurfaceIdentity.
Unknown, absent, malformed, substituted, or ambiguous identity components fail closed without writes.
No alternate caller-authored expectation can substitute for package or journey authority.
required_validation: positive exact same-package same-home cache promotion
tree, context, candidate, observation, and journey substitution rejection
zero hidden writes for read and reconciliation paths
focused package identity suite twice, dependency-closed distribution suite, full distribution suite, all-targets check, and authoritative WorkerResult-v1 validation with 16 jobs and threads
worker_result_requirements: Freeze exact regular single-link artifact rows, sorted artifact aggregate, bytes, context and candidate binding, exact commands and outcomes, negative controls, authorized effects, requested root-only changes, unsupported claims, and the exact no-claim statement.
stop_rule: Stop on any need to alter shared or root-owned authority, any effect outside isolated local test roots, or any inability to bind package version and journey root before promotion.
no_claim_statement: This corrective work package does not claim package identity acceptance, installation, cache, marketplace, app-registry, Plugins UI, discovery, runtime, readiness, release, node closure, or completion.
